title: Ideal Ground Truth Sensor
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Ideal_Ground_Truth_Sensor.md
text: 从驾驶场景或 RoadRunner Scenario 生成真值测量，作为传感器检测或航迹报告；输出 4 路；按 {Lane boundaries reported by sensor} 指定传感器报告的车道边界 Ego；{Unique identifier of sensor} 指定唯一传感器标识符 positive integer、{Types of detections generated by sensor} 由传感器生成的检测类型 Objects、{Required interval between sensor updates (s)} 指定传感器更新之间的必需时间间隔、{Sensor’s (x,y,z) position (m)} 指定传感器在自车上的安装位置、{Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定传感器的偏航角、{Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定传感器的俯仰角、{Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定传感器的横滚角、{Field of view [Azimuth, Elevation] (deg)} 指定传感器的角度视场、{Maximum detection range (m)} 指定传感器的最大检测距离、{Coordinate system used to report objects} 指定报告的检测的坐标系 Host、{Point on target used to report position} 用于报告位置的目标参与者上的点 Origin、{Output format of reported targets} 指定传感器报告目标参与者的格式 Object、{Maximum number of object detections reported} 指定传感器报告的目标检测最大数量、{Maximum number of lane boundary detections reported} 指定报告的车道最大数量、{Source of object bus name} 指定目标总线名称来源、{Specify an output object bus name} 输出目标总线名称 BusSSFGroundTruth、{Source of lane bus name} 指定车道检测总线名称来源、{Specify an output lane bus name} 输出目标总线名称 BusSSFGroundTruth，按实例取值。

params.name: Unique identifier of sensor
params.values: 唯一传感器标识符 positive integer

params.name: Types of detections generated by sensor
params.values: 选择由传感器生成的检测类型 Objects Only (default) | Objects and Lanes

params.name: Required interval between sensor updates (s)
params.values: 传感器更新之间的必需时间间隔 0.1 | positive real scalar

params.name: Sensor’s (x,y,z) position (m)
params.values: 传感器在自车上的安装位置 [1.9 0 0.2] (default) | 1-by-3 real-valued vector of form [ x y z ]

params.name: Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)
params.values: 传感器的偏航角 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)
params.values: 传感器的俯仰角 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)
params.values: 传感器的横滚角 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Field of view [Azimuth, Elevation] (deg)
params.values: 传感器的角度视场 [120 30] (default) | real-valued 1-by-2 vector of positive values

params.name: Maximum detection range (m)
params.values: 传感器的最大检测距离 50 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Coordinate system used to report objects
params.values: 报告的检测的坐标系 Host Coordinates (default) | Sensor Coordinates

params.name: Point on target used to report position
params.values: 用于报告位置的目标参与者上的点 Origin Point (default) | Closest Point | Rear Center

params.name: Output format of reported targets
params.values: 传感器报告目标参与者的格式 Object detections (default) | Tracks | Target Poses

params.name: Maximum number of object detections reported
params.values: 传感器报告的目标检测最大数量 300 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Lane boundaries reported by sensor

params.name: Maximum number of lane boundary detections reported
params.values: 报告的车道最大数量 300 (default) | positive integer
